Telephone conversation between the Foreign Ministers of the Islamic Republic of Iran and India

Iran’s Foreign Minister, while outlining the latest regional developments and clarifying the positions of the Islamic Republic of Iran, identified the United States’ breach of commitments and the continuation of military aggression against Iran, including the naval blockade and attacks on Iran’s commercial shipping, as the main cause of insecurity in the region and the Strait of Hormuz.
